acceptanceCriteria: isTestPath classifies spec/**/*_spec.rb as a test, with a test.
The local rubyTestPath in ruby_autoload.go is removed or delegates to the shared helper.
Any analyzer-schema or receipt byte change is recorded.
body: Residual from V1-1674 (PR #1088). Expected: the shared isTestPath in internal/contextindex treats spec/models/thing_spec.rb (RSpec layout: spec/ directory, _spec.rb suffix) as a test. Actual: it returns false; the lane added a local rubyTestPath in ruby_autoload.go so the fixture's spec row ranks as a test rather than a plain reference. Other impact paths that use isTestPath still misclassify RSpec files.
title: isTestPath does not classify RSpec spec/ and _spec.rb Ruby paths as tests
